name: Utah
summary_text: First state to criminalise adult restroom use (HB 257, 2024) — not just school facilities — and first to explicitly prohibit LGBTQ flags at government buildings and schools (May 2025, fines up to $500/day). Below the national score 0.36.

sources.title: Scared advertisers, flag bans and Trump: the US is in for a troubled Pride 2025 | US news | The Guardian
sources.claim_summary: Guardian report (29 May 2025) on Pride 2025 in the US: on 7 May Utah became the first state to explicitly prohibit flying LGBTQ+ flags at government buildings and schools, with fines of $500 a day; Utah Pride's executive director says the state 'leads the nation in anti-LGBTQ legislation'; similar flag bans were signed in Idaho and Montana, while Salt Lake City issued counter-flags and Boise made the pride flag an official city flag.
